# vergeio_nodes (Data Source)

Node data source schema

## Example Usage

```terraform



# Networks data source fetches the Network from the VergeIO.

data "vergeio_nodes" "all" {
}
output "nodes" {
  value = data.vergeio_nodes.all
}

# Add a filter to see information on a specific node

data "vergeio_nodes" "all" {
  filter_name = "node1"
}
output "nodes" {
  value = data.vergeio_nodes.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Filter by name

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) List of Nodes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>

### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description
- `id` (Number) Id
- `name` (String) Name
